claim_statement: In Evo2-7B's Layer-26 SAE, a set-level group of features selectively marks alpha-helix codons (frozen round-1 feature set S, cross-organism), beyond confounds and multiple-testing chance.
variant_metric: prokaryote set-AUROC (H-only) = 0.906 (mean over 3 seeds); eukaryote = 0.868 (mean over 3 seeds); shuffle-null ~0.48; both meet bar >= 0.80
delta: +0.005 prokaryote (H-only vs HGI); -0.002 eukaryote (H-only vs HGI) — negligible, within seed-to-seed variance
reasoning: The H-only helix definition (strict alpha only, excludes 3-10 G and pi I helices) produces set-AUROC 0.906 (prokaryote) and 0.868 (eukaryote), both well above the 0.80 pass threshold and essentially identical to the HGI results (0.901/0.866). Shuffle-null remains ~0.48 and confound-only ~0.50, confirming the gap is real. The result is consistent with the main experiment: the frozen S features mark alpha-helix codons robustly regardless of whether G/I helices are included in the label model. C1 is supported under H-only.
